'''Karalle''' was a [[Swamp/Legends|swamp]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. It was on this planet that the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|force-sensitive]] [[Quermian/Legends|Quermian]] [[Jarea Kaela/Legends|Jarea Kaela]] hid from [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] and the [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitorius]].<ref name="Savage Spirits" />
